title: Manager, object and selection: when an edit becomes persistent
goal: Distinguish manager lookup, editable object and selection cursor while testing the moment a name is saved.
prerequisites: onec.p3; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Find an item by code without substituting name text for identity.
Show that an in-memory edit requires Записать.
Advance a selection with Следующий and locate the desired reference among other items.
sections: Catalogs.Customers provides type-wide creation and lookup operations.GetObject belongs to a particular reference; a selection traverses items. A manager is not an already-loaded array of objects: traversal and reads follow the API’s rules.

Справочники.Клиенты manages this object kind: it creates items and finds references by code within the catalog. ПолучитьОбъект gives an editable state of one record. After changing its name but before Записать, a fresh read should still see the stored name. After writing, lookup by the same code returns the new name.

AfterSelect, advance withNext in a loop. Read fields from the current position, not before the first advance. Test an empty selection separately: zero iterations should produce the agreed empty result. Traversed count alone does not prove there were no hidden conditions.

A selection starts before its first row. Пока Выборка.Следующий() advances the cursor and reports whether another row exists. The example compares references instead of relying on a fixed position. Additional customers need not be deleted to match an illustration.

For one card, obtain the object, validate current data andWrite. Bulk edits during traversal need care: changing selection conditions may affect later membership. In the starter exercise, collect references first and modify them in a separate controlled pass.

Separate object, reference and selection row. Persistence occurs explicitly through Черновик.Записать(). An in-memory presentation change is not a durable result. Bulk processing needs separate filter, transaction, permission and performance rules; one teaching loop does not establish them.

For reporting reads, compare identities and call counts with no writes. For one-card editing, compare only expected fields. Include empty sets and repeated execution. This shows the API choice follows the task rather than an accidental chain of unnecessary object accesses.

The original returns three true claims: unchanged storage before write, changed storage afterward and the desired reference found in selection. The incorrect variant omits writing: syntax remains valid and the item is found, but its new name is not stored. Each execution creates one test item; remove its startup call and record its code afterward.
